g.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Difference in quantile score (twice the mean pinball loss over 11 quantiles, points of effective capacity) between two convex-model forecasts, at each of 12 quarterly origins and pooled over all 12 at the right. Below zero favours the first-named forecast. Dot: estimate. Line: 95% interval from resampling one-week blocks (pooled: 99% interval from resampling months). Grey bar: tie band, one standard error. Five substations, rows outside switching events.'

text.font-family: Matter XH, DM Sans, sans-serif
text.tspan: Difference in quantile score (twice the mean pinball loss over 11 quantiles, points of
effective capacity) between two convex-model forecasts, at each of 12 quarterly origins and
pooled over all 12 at the right. Below zero favours the first-named forecast. Dot: estimate.
Line: 95% interval from resampling one-week blocks (pooled: 99% interval from resampling
months). Grey bar: tie band, one standard error. Five substations, rows outside switching
